_doc: Client-path canary registry (SO_TECH_VANGUARD_ELEVATION_20260621 §2a). Tools touching client-send path or client PII adopt immediately but run on Loucks-as-client (internal) traffic only for 7 days with output diff captured. Graduates to live client traffic on launch criterion: zero send-path defects across the 7-day window. Owner: Sterling (A7). Hale integration: canary status flows into morning brief; defect closure reaches Commander.
